yt_title: The $1,850 job hiding in a 2003–05 Range Rover

scenes.caption: The $1,850 job hiding in this Range Rover
scenes.voice: Shopping for a 2003 to 2005 Range Rover with the 4.4 V8? Listen for a rattle at start-up.

scenes.caption: Plastic chain guides go brittle with age
scenes.voice: Its BMW V8 uses plastic timing-chain guides. As the tensioner weakens, the chain slaps them until they break.

scenes.caption: About $1,850 in parts. 26 hours of work.
scenes.voice: A full kit runs about eighteen hundred and fifty dollars, and one owner logged twenty-six hours doing it with the engine in.

scenes.caption: A new tensioner early can save the guides
scenes.voice: The cheap insurance? A new tensioner early can save the guides.

end.sub: The full job, the parts and the mistakes:
end.voice: The whole job, step by step, is on boxy trucks dot com.
